protocol_changes: Strict full-output matching of case-insensitive Yes/No/Y/N; existing outer Markdown and one sentence-ending punctuation mark supported; exact Chinese yes/no forms retained only where originally supported.
Unknown votes remain unresolved and route to the existing full-label selection once, rather than being treated as No; no per-label retry is added.
With no Unknown votes, the original zero/one/multiple Yes candidate paths remain, except invalid multi-candidate arbitration now returns Data Conf instead of the first candidate.
A valid full-label selection is kept; invalid full-label selection returns Data Conf.
Save semicolon-separated unknown_labels and fallback_reason in every prediction; original helper three-value return remains, with an optional diagnostics=None parameter.

For 23 truncating generic wrappers, add return_full_text=False and use True only for Y/N, so strict parsing sees cross-line conflicts. Three GPT-oss wrappers and four Qwen paths already returning full visible text are unchanged.

fallback_reason_values.unresolved_votes_full_label: At least one undecided vote triggered existing full-label selection.
fallback_reason_values.no_positive_votes_full_label: No Yes votes and no undecided votes triggered existing full-label selection.
fallback_reason_values.candidate_arbitration_invalid: Multi-candidate arbitration invalid/outside candidates; final Data Conf.
fallback_reason_values.;full_label_parse_failed: Suffix appended when full-label selection is invalid; final Data Conf.
